models.name: creatify-lipsync
models.description: Realistic lipsync video - optimized for speed, quality, and consistency.

models.name: bytedance-seedream-v4-edit
models.description: Seedream v4 Edit refines or transforms existing images based on a new prompt and a reference. Instead of masking, you provide a source image and describe how it should be altered — adjusting style, details, or replacing elements while keeping the subject consistent.

models.name: happy-horse-1-image-to-video
models.description: Happy Horse 1.0 Image to Video — bring still images to life with fluid, expressive animation. Selectable output resolution (720p/1080p) — price scales with the resolution chosen.

models.name: kling-v2.1-pro-i2v
models.description: Kling 2.1 Pro is the high-end version of Kuaishou’s video generation model, offering enhanced realism, longer motion sequences, and cinematic quality. In I2V mode, it animates static images with fluid environmental effects.

models.name: flux-3-dev
models.description: FLUX 3 Dev is the faster, lower-cost variant of Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3 frontier model, planned for open-weight release. It trades a small amount of peak fidelity for significantly reduced latency and price, making it well suited for rapid iteration, prototyping, and high-volume text-to-image generation.

models.name: nano-banana
models.description: Nano Banana is an advanced AI model excelling in natural language-driven image generation and editing. It produces hyper-realistic, physics-aware visuals with seamless style transformations.

models.name: seedance-2-t2v
models.description: SD 2.0 is the latest multimodal video generation model by ByteDance, offering advanced camera control, native audio-video sync, and high-resolution output. Selectable output resolution (480p/720p) — price scales with the resolution chosen.

models.name: gpt-5-2
models.description: GPT 5.2 is a lightweight reasoning model with fast response times and deep coding capabilities. Supports image inputs, system prompts, web search capabilities, and reasoning effort control. Pricing: $1.25/M input tokens, $9.00/M output tokens.
